messages:
Sam: Kickoff: RivenHealth onboarding. Quick objectives: align contacts, list success metrics, and sketch a 30/60 plan. Renewal window: 2028-12. Dana: Thanks team  primary needs: HIPAA-safe ingest, SSO, and low-latency clinician chat. Omar: Ill own data ingest and initial prompt tuning. Need a sanitized sample file + field map. ETA ~7 business days after file. Priya: Platform will provision a sandbox and staging model. Need allowlist IPs and expected concurrency. Can do infra prep in 3 days after allowlist. Ally (Security): For PHI we need a signed BAA and a data flow diagram. Log retention request? Dana: 12 months and audit export. Sam: Proposed success criteria: 1) End-to-end sandbox (ingest->embeddings->chat) with sanitized data; 2) Okta SSO with 3 test users; 3) Staging p50 latency <350ms; 4) BAA signed; 5) KT + runbook recorded. Dana: Agree. Risks: delayed sample, Okta metadata issues, legal delays, quality drop from quantization. Action items: Dana - provide sanitized sample & field map (due Thu); Omar - ingest scaffold & mapping doc (due next Mon); Priya - sandbox + offerlist confirm (due Fri); Ally - BAA checklist + retention options (due Wed); Sam - create weekly cadence & onboarding doc (today). scheduler-bot: Meeting scheduled: "RivenHealth Integration - Weekly" Fri 11:00 PT starting 3950000600. Omar: Small config snippet well need from customer:
``
S3_BUCKET=riven-sandbox
PREFIX=patient-data/
REDACT_FIELDS=ssn,email
``
Dana: Will provision and DM creds to Omar. Sam: Ill post the onboarding checklist + invite link here once ready. Ping me for anything urgent. :rocket:
